clo_details: Understand the basics of computer vision, its related fields, and its applications
Understand the concepts of image formation: image representation, lighting, image acquisition through the camera, camera calibration techniques.
Basic knowledge of image processing on points, lines, image filtering techniques and corresponding algorithm implementation
Understand the techniques of feature extraction and matching, implement the techniques of edges, lines extraction
Understand the basics of segmentation, techniques such as active contours, split and merge, mean shift and mode finding
Discuss feature-based alignments like 2D and 3D feature-based alignment
Discuss the principles and the implementation of Image stitching
Understand and implement the object detection techniques
Explain the principles of face recognition, object tracking
